productOverview: Wingtip Insight Cloud is a hosted retail analytics platform exposing a REST/GraphQL API for sales, inventory, and customer analytics, with pre-built dashboards and a data pipeline that ingests POS and e-commerce feeds. Sold as a usage-priced API product with an optional dashboard UI layer.
keyCapabilities: REST and GraphQL analytics APIs over sales, inventory, and customer datasets
Prebuilt POS and e-commerce connectors (Shopify, Square, Lightspeed)
Near-real-time streaming ingestion with sub-15-minute data freshness SLA
Scheduled exports to data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse)
constraints: GraphQL API rate-limited to 500 requests/minute per tenant on Standard plan
Historical backfill limited to 24 months of POS data at onboarding
White-label dashboard branding requires Enterprise plan
Data warehouse export scheduling minimum interval is hourly, not real-time
licensingModel: Usage-based subscription priced per monthly API call volume and connected store count, with an optional flat-fee dashboard add-on.

sla.support: Email/chat business hours (Standard), 24x7 on-call for API outages (Enterprise)

security.encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit
security.dataResidency: Customer-selectable: US, EU, or APAC (Australia) region

pricing.model: Base platform fee plus metered API calls and per-store connector fee
